review_content: I wanted to love this bra, but even after sizing myself multiple times and ordering two different sizes neither of them worked comfortably. The 32 D was way too tight around the band and the cup size was too large and the 34 C was a bit more comfortable around, but the cup size was too large. I'm 5'3" and 115lbs. At Victoria Secret I've measured as a 32 C and 32 D in the past for reference, but haven't been measured in some time. Seamless bras I wear a size small. Outside of sizing issues the bra is very soft and seamless underneath tight tops. I think if the bra fit properly this would be a 10/10.

review_content: Flattering cut unlike many pumping/nursing combo bras. It looks good under my shirts. The clasps for the cups are nicely designed so you can just unfasten once while nursing or pumping. The layers are still a bit cumbersome under your boob while trying to nurse. Sometimes the back hooks can be uncomfortable. You have many options to customize the fit (tighten or loosen straps, an adjustable bra strap design holding the bra together when fully opened for nursing which I've never seen before and doesn't require you to smooth back down after every session, and an expander). I'd consider getting another color if it were on sale.
review_content_ch:
讨喜的设计，但仍有改进空间。
剪裁讨喜，不像许多吸奶器/哺乳两用内衣。穿在衬衫里面很好看。罩杯的搭扣设计得很好，哺乳或吸奶时只需解开一次。不过哺乳时，胸部下方的几层布料还是有些累赘。有时后背的挂钩会不舒服。有多种调节松紧的选项（可收紧或放松肩带，还有可调节的背带设计，在完全打开哺乳时能将内衣固定在一起——这种设计我以前从未见过，而且每次喂奶后不需要重新抚平，还有延长扣）。如果打折的话，我会考虑再买一个颜色。
review_summary: 设计美观，哺乳和吸奶时只需解开一次扣子，但胸部下方多层布料有些碍事，后背挂钩偶尔不适。提供多种调节选项，包括独特的全开式哺乳设计。

review_content: Pretty dissapointed. I've only worn this for three work shifts and already it has lost its shape. The part in the back where the tag is, is stretched and warped, as well as the bottom and sides. It does not look like it did when it arrived. It now constantly bunches up in the back. It is also difficult to pull tight and line up evenly even if you lie down. It did not feel supportive at all, more like wearing a too tight tshirt. Also, it created a vertical line under my work shirt where the velcro attatched and was noticable by many people. I spent too much time re wrapping it only to have it slip down, bunch up and roll up when I sat down. On the hopes mine is defective, I am considering exchanging it. But after close inspection it seems its just made of a cheap material that doesn't maintain its original shape. I wouldn't wear it in the summer, its winter here and this "brace" heats you up quickly. Only plus is that it isn't itchy.
review_content_ch:
变形、起皱且失去形状
非常失望。我只穿了三个班次，它就已经变形了。背面标签处拉伸扭曲，底部和侧面也是如此。看起来和刚收到时完全不同。现在背面总是皱成一团。即使躺下也很难拉紧并保持平整。完全没有支撑感，更像是穿了一件太紧的T恤。而且魔术贴位置在我的工作服下形成明显竖纹，很多人都注意到了。我花了太多时间重新缠绕，但只要一坐下就会滑落、起皱并卷边。希望我这条是次品，正在考虑换货。但仔细检查后发现，它只是用廉价材料制成，无法保持原状。夏天我不会穿它，虽然现在是冬天，但这个"束腹带"很快就会让人发热。唯一的优点是它不扎皮肤。
review_summary: 产品仅穿三次就变形，背部标签处、底部和侧面均出现拉伸扭曲，无法保持原状。穿戴时易在背部堆积，难以均匀拉紧，支撑感差如紧身T恤。魔术贴处会在工作服下形成明显垂直线条，频繁下滑堆积。材质廉价不耐用，冬季穿戴易发热，唯一优点是不刺痒。

review_content: Pros; the clasps work great, smooth, easy to use one handed for on and off. The fabric is soft and stretchy, the straps hold their place all day and night. The pads are squishy and give easy when im full of milk and still fit comfortably when im not. The color is spot on! I got pink and grey and they resemble their picture beautifully. They come with clip extensions, which the fabric is pretty stretchy so i dint need them. I especially love that the holding straps that connect the cup to the shoulder straps is wide at the bottom. Most other nursing bras just have a flimsy thin strap and it does nothing, but i really love the design this one has. Cons; the cups are flat and do put pressure on the nips without much give or proper shaping. The pads arent sewn in, they move A LOT when folding down to feed or when thrown in the wash. Overall they’re great bras, now a lot of reviews say the sizing can be off varying between the bra options. i got the grey and pink, and at a size 36 C they fit me perfectly with a little room to grow. Now to note, the wide strap thats sewn into the cup- its so big that it does get a little milk soaked when leaking, i use nip pads and put them behind it so they dont come off when i fold the cup down for feeding. I dont mind this at all but someone may. I would definitely recommend this bra.
review_content_ch:
毕加索款，我很喜欢。👌
优点：搭扣顺滑好用，单手就能轻松穿脱。面料柔软有弹性，肩带整天整夜都不移位。胸垫柔软有弹性，涨奶时能轻松延展，空杯时也贴合舒适。颜色完全符合预期！我买了粉色和灰色，实物与图片完全一致。附带延长扣，但面料弹性很好所以我没用上。特别喜欢连接罩杯和肩带的承托带底部加宽设计，多数哺乳文胸只用单薄细带毫无作用，这款设计深得我心。缺点：罩杯较平，对乳头压迫明显缺乏缓冲和塑形。胸垫未缝合，哺乳时翻折或洗涤时容易移位。总体是款优秀的文胸，但很多评论提到不同款式尺码可能不准。我穿36C的灰粉款非常合身且略有富余。需注意罩杯缝合的宽承托带面积较大，漏奶时容易浸湿，我使用防溢乳垫垫在后面防止哺乳翻折时脱落。个人不介意这点但有人可能在意。强烈推荐这款文胸。
review_summary: 优点：卡扣顺滑可单手操作，面料柔软有弹性，肩带固定好，垫子柔软适应涨奶，颜色准确，附带延长扣，连接杯的宽肩带设计好；缺点：罩杯扁平压迫乳头，内置垫子不移位易移动，宽肩带吸奶但可用乳头垫解决。

As a busy breastfeeding mom, I depend on this pump daily, so charging problems make it impossible to use when I need it most. The reason I’m giving this review instead of simply moving on to another product is because I genuinely like it and want it to work. The comfort, convenience, and performance are excellent. I’m just hesitant to purchase another one if these charging issues continue to happen. I’m hoping the company sees this review and can offer some guidance, a solution, or perhaps recommend a more reliable version. I truly want to remain a customer because when this pump works, it’s outstanding.

review_content: This thing has so many "noise" settings that it's sure to satisfy almost everyone. However, the form factor of this thing is pretty poor. The power chord plugs in to the bottom of the unit, and its 'feet' are so short the chord has to be perfectly flat or the unit doesn't sit flat on all four feet and instead rocks unevenly back and forth. It also has this blue power indicator light that is so bright I'm pretty sure you could see it from the moon, which is pretty distracting when you're trying to go to sleep in a dark room and your ceiling is glowing blue; on top of that, the light isn't even on or beside the power button, so you have to fish around for the power, or the volume, or the noise selection buttons. Pretty terrible design. And THEN there's the issue of this thing making some sort of artifact noises while it's going. I'm not sure how to explain this, but each time I use the unit, there's some sort of background noise but it's always different, and it's not part of the noise you've selected, and the volume of this artifact noise increases or decreases along with the volume of the intended noise, so you can't drown it out. It's super frustrating when you're trying to go to sleep, and this artifact noise just keeps repeating over and over again. I'm not sure what to make of this. Overall, I am pretty dissatisfied with this unit and do not recommend it for those who rely on white noise and dark rooms to get to sleep.
review_content_ch:
外形设计糟糕，还会发出诡异的杂音
这台机器的"噪音"模式多到几乎能满足所有人需求。但它的外形设计实在差劲：电源线插在底部，而支脚太短，必须让电源线完全平铺才能四脚着地，否则就会前后摇晃不平衡。更糟的是那个蓝色电源指示灯，亮得简直能从月球上看见——在黑暗卧室里试图入睡时，天花板泛着蓝光特别干扰注意力；而且这灯居然不在电源键旁边，你得摸索着找电源键、音量键或噪音选择键。设计太糟糕了。最要命的是机器运行时会产生某种杂音，每次使用背景杂音都不同，且不属于你选择的噪音类型，这些杂音还会随着主音量同步增减，根本无法掩盖。当你试图入睡时，这些不断重复的杂音简直令人崩溃。总体而言，我对这台机器非常不满，不推荐依赖白噪音和黑暗环境入睡的人购买。
review_summary: 产品设计存在多个问题：电源线插口位于底部且支脚过短导致放置不稳；蓝色电源指示灯过亮且位置不便；运行时会产生不可预测的背景噪音，无法通过调节音量消除。

review_content: Great lower back support and breathable fabric! (Although baby still gets hot, so I just undo the head support for a few minutes while manually supporting her head.) The buckle connecting the shoulder straps (upper back) is difficult if you have a neck/shoulder injury, but doable. High quality carrier worth the extra money. Only reason I gave 4 stars instead of 5 is that it's advertised as suitable for newborn infants in the fetal position, but you have to make your own insert with a rolled blanket/towel. review_content_ch:

腰部支撑很好，面料透气！（虽然宝宝还是会热，所以我手动扶着她的头，把头枕解开几分钟。）肩带连接处（上背部）的扣子对于颈部/肩部受伤的人来说比较难扣，但也不是扣不上。这款背带质量很好，值得多花点钱。唯一给4星而不是5星的原因是，它宣称适合胎儿姿势的新生儿，但你必须用卷起的毯子/毛巾自己做内垫。一边要托着新生儿，一边要扣上带子，还要防止毯子散开，这比想象中更需要技巧。如果自带内垫，我愿意多付5-10美元。不过，考虑到质量、支撑性和适应性，我仍然强烈推荐这款背带。

review_content: I tried to do the whole "put the bottle in warm water" thing to warm up the milk, but it was so time consuming. The bottle warmer gets the job done is much quicker, and I can change a quick diaper while it's warming up. For the money, it was well worth it! This is even the brand the daycare uses. There's a pamphlet about where to fill the line with water so it isn't too hot or cold, but after 3 or 4 tries, you get a feel of how much to fill the thing up to. Some commenters said it didn't make it hot enough or it was too hot, but that's probably because their fridge is up high (like mine), so the milk is super cold, or they let the bottle sit in the warmer for a while after it clicks off. The inside of the warmer does stay hot after turning off, just like a stove would, so just take the bottle out right away, or don't put as much water in and it'll turn off sooner. Simple.

review_content: I love this Boppy Uplift Nursing Pillow. I have struggled with proper breastfeeding posture (no, really though...3 breastfed babies later and I have an actual hump I need to go to the chiropractor for). I didn't get this pillow for reflux related issues though it certainly looks like it could help with that. I got it so that I would have an easier time maintaining a better posture while breastfeeding. The thicker end and FIRMNESS of the pillow are exactly what I was looking for. I actually keep this one in our van for breastfeeding on the go. That higher end helps me not to have to bend my back and neck so much to be the right height for baby especially in the van which makes for an even harder feeding space. This is a firm pillow which I love. The soft ones have their place too (I like to have a soft boppy and a firm one), but this is better for maintaining good posture. The sturdy clip and adjustable waistband are excellent for keeping the pillow and baby close. I highly recommend this one! The functionality and quality are excellent. The design is simple but cute.

结实、高质量的枕头
我喜欢这款 Boppy Uplift 哺乳枕。我一直难以保持正确的母乳喂养姿势（真的，喂了三个母乳宝宝后，我背都驼了，需要去看脊椎按摩师）。我买这个枕头不是为了解决胃食管反流问题，虽然它看起来确实可能有助于缓解。我买它是为了在母乳喂养时更容易保持良好姿势。枕头较厚的一端和硬度正是我想要的。我实际上把这个枕头放在我们的面包车里，方便外出哺乳。那个较高的一端帮助我不用弯腰和低头太多，就能达到宝宝的合适高度，尤其是在面包车里，那里喂奶空间更困难。这是一个硬质枕头，我很喜欢。软枕头也有它们的用处（我喜欢有一个软 Boppy 和一个硬质的），但这个更适合保持良好姿势。结实的扣子和可调节腰带非常适合让枕头和宝宝贴近。我强烈推荐这款！功能性和质量都很棒。设计简单但可爱。

review_content: I can’t tell you how many pillows I have purchased over the years to ease my neck and shoulder pain. I’ve bought cervical pillows, hybrids, goose, down, beads, memory foam….you name it. I always woke up with shoulder and neck pain. I tend to move around when I sleep. Probably because of the pain and I’m trying to get comfortable. Now, to this pillow. I recently had 3 spontaneous dissections in my neck that lead to strokes. The doctors have no idea yet what’s causing the dissections and tell me to take it very easy with my neck. I’m in pain. I can’t get comfortable. I’m desperate. In the hospital, I could raise the hospital bed and put the side railings up to prop pillows around me. I made myself a little supportive nest. But at home I had nothing like that. I remembered about pregnancy pillows and came across this pillow and ordered it. This pillow has been wonderful for my healing. I am finally able to get comfortable and relax. I don’t have near the neck tension and zero shoulder pain. It provides support around my entire body. I can lay on either side or on my back. I can prop myself where I feel like I’m sleeping on my stomach. I have finally been able to get the rest I needed to heal. The only thing I didn’t like is the cover. The cover is super soft and plush but very warm. I sleep hot. I ordered a jersey knit pillow cover from the same company, I believe, and it’s perfect.
review_content_ch:
作为枕头鉴赏家，这是我最爱的一款
多年来我买了无数枕头来缓解颈肩疼痛——颈椎枕、混合枕、鹅绒枕、羽绒枕、颗粒枕、记忆棉枕…应有尽有。但每天醒来依然颈肩酸痛。我睡觉时总辗转反侧，可能因为疼痛想调整到舒适姿势。直到遇见这款孕妇枕：近期我颈部突发三次血管剥离导致中风，医生尚未查明原因，只叮嘱我必须小心保护颈部。疼痛让我无法安眠，近乎绝望。住院时我能调高病床，用护栏围住身体堆砌枕头，给自己造了个支撑窝。但回家后束手无策，突然想起孕妇枕便下单了这款。它对我的康复堪称奇迹——终于能舒适放松入睡，颈部紧绷感基本消失，肩膀完全不痛。它提供全身环绕支撑，侧卧或仰卧都行，甚至能模拟趴睡姿势。我终于获得了康复所需的休息。唯一不满的是枕套：虽然超柔软蓬松但太闷热（我本身易发热），后来买了同品牌的针织枕套就完美了。
review_summary: 优点：缓解颈肩疼痛，提供全身支撑，能侧卧、仰卧或类似俯卧睡姿，帮助恢复。缺点：原装枕套过于温暖，睡热的人不适，需更换为针织枕套。

review_content: Although my baby won't be here for a few more months I am very excited to use this wrap. Honestly, if your buying it for the four in 1 side of things then I think you will be disappointed. It's a wrap just like any other so I'm not really sure how it's supposed to wrap around your carrier or anything like that. It's not what I bought it for anyway though! That being said, I've had a Moby wrap before, and the cuddle bug material is way softer and way more stretchy! And shorter which I actually love! Im only 5 foot 2 inches tall so the moby just had too much fabric for me. I felt swaddled in it! This is much easier for me to put on. It comes with a carrying pouch for the wrap made out of the same material. I stuck my three year old in the wrap just experimenting with how the wrap would hold her weight and it actually did AMAZING. So I have no doubt it will hold up to my newborn in December. So considering the nice price, good length, super soft material, and its ability to hold up my three year old with as strechy as the material is I give it five stars. I will come make and change it if I find it doesn't do well for my newborn but I have a pretty good feeling it will be one of my favorite baby accessories.
review_content_ch:
肯定比Moby好。尤其对我们矮个子来说！！
虽然我的宝宝还有几个月才出生，但我已经非常兴奋地要使用这款背巾了。说实话，如果你是为了它所谓的“四合一”功能而买，我觉得你会失望的。它就像其他任何背巾一样，所以我不太确定它到底要怎么绕在婴儿背带或其他东西上。不过，我本来也不是为了这个才买的！话虽如此，我之前用过Moby背巾，而Cuddle Bug的材质更柔软、更有弹性！而且更短，我其实很喜欢这一点！我只有5英尺2英寸高，所以Moby的布料对我来说太多了。我觉得自己被裹在里面了！这款背巾对我来说穿起来更容易。它配有一个用同样材质做的便携收纳袋。我试着把三岁的孩子放进背巾里，测试它是否能承受她的体重，结果它的表现真的太棒了。所以我毫不怀疑它能在12月支撑住我的新生儿。考虑到实惠的价格、合适的长度、超柔软的材质，以及它能在如此有弹性的情况下撑起我三岁孩子的能力，我给五星好评。如果我发现它对我的新生儿效果不好，我会回来修改评价，但我很有信心它会成为我最喜欢的婴儿用品之一。

review_content: I have a six month old who is super clingy and needs both white noise and a small amount of warm light to settle down during nap times and bedtime. I was so excited to get to try this out for both the various sounds and the adjustable light and WOW it has exceeded my expectations! The only reason it’s not a perfect five stars is because of the app situation, which I will do my best to explain below. Technically, yes: you can use this without app control, via the buttons around the machine. That said, you are relatively limited by way of essential functions like being able to set the clock. There is no manual way to set the clock without a wifi connection and connection to the device via the app. I was able to find a free version of the Tuya Home app (the one in blue on the Apple App Store) but the two apps listed as preferred by the company cost a small monthly or annual fee, which I feel the product listing needs to be clearer on. If you already have a bunch of devices in your home powered by an inclusive, household app control, chances are this machine with pair with your existing app just fine; we just aren’t quite there yet in our home. If you do not wish to download an app and connect this to WiFi, you can still adjust things like sound options, volume, light color, brightness, and are able to pause or start the sound machine itself. All of these functions come with easy to figure out buttons along the top of the device. With the app, you have a ton more options for noise settings and it’s SO awesome being able to adjust the white noise setting, volume, and brightness from your phone, especially with a baby in the next room over who you would otherwise disrupt by having to physically enter the room, click buttons and toggle the volume manually. So the app works wonders for our home situation and I have found it really straightforward and user friendly via Tuya Home. I have included screenshots of the app screen to show just a small sample of the sound options, volume control and brightness control as it appears on my phone, all of which are linked up to the actual DreamEgg device in the video. Not pictured are additional sound options, including: white, pink, brown and green noise options, different fan sound options (the airplane fan sound is pretty awesome), and nine different “melodies,” that range from twinkle twinkle little star to Brahms, Mozart, a quiet harp loop and a piano setting, all of which are just nice, pleasant, soothing loops of familiar songs and sounds, depending on personal preference and what helps you sleep best at night. For example: My husband needs the tv on to help him sleep when he is restless and the melodies work for him. My baby needs consistent “whooshing” sounds, so the white-green noise settings and the womb settings are perfect for him. I prefer nature sounds like rain, rainstorm, and ocean waves, which are also included. Truly, there are so many options that suit so many different preferences and this is really thoughtfully made and inclusive for literally every single person in our home. I’m going to have to buy another one for our bedroom once we move baby into his nursery full time and it’s pretty awesome that both sound/light machines can be controlled from the same app on my phone, so yes, I am a fan of the app control. My baby is thus far loving the womb sound and the orange, low glow of the diffused light, and I can already tell this is going to help us get through a current sleep regression caused by teething and growing pains. He is currently sleeping so peacefully with the warm light and womb sounds as I sit here and slowly dim the light from my cell phone in the next room over. When I need to do some dishes or otherwise make some noise, I can either change the sound settings to a flatter pink noise or turn the womb sound up from my phone to keep him asleep and undisturbed. I truly wish this technology existed long ago, when I was in college and living with roommates, as the white noise (I call it that but it’s truthfully 34 noise/sound options) will legitimately drown out so much background noise from clanking dishes to “inside voice” level chatter and even movie nights with my hubby. The alarm function seems simple enough to set, snooze and you can select time, frequency, specific sound and volume for each alarm, and have it set and ready for the morning. We are currently not using alarm clocks because our baby IS the alarm clock, but this is a neat way to customize an alarm with light, sound and increasing volume. All in all? There’s something for everyone, all wrapped in a perfectly sized, slim profile, easy on the eyes device. It’s helping us sleep, it is easy as pie to learn to use and control via the app or buttons, and my only wish is that it came with the option of a remote control for people who do not like to connect a bunch of devices to their phone or WiFi. Compared to the similar options on ours and other parents’ baby registries, I think the performance, quality, functionality and personalization are all of wonderful quality for the cost, so long as the app control remains free for us.
review_content_ch:
这简直太棒了！
我家六个月大的宝宝特别粘人，白天小睡和晚上睡觉时既需要白噪音又需要一点暖光才能安静下来。试用这款产品时，我既为各种声音选择兴奋，又为可调灯光惊喜——结果完全超出预期！没给五星的唯一原因是APP问题，我会在下文详细说明。

技术上确实可以不依赖APP：机器周围的按钮就能操作。但核心功能受限，比如设置时钟必须通过APP连接WiFi实现。我在苹果应用商店找到了蓝色图标的涂鸦家庭APP免费版，但厂商推荐的两款APP需要月费/年费，这点产品页面应该写得更清楚。如果你家已有统一控制的多款智能设备，这台机器很可能兼容现有APP——只是我们家还没到这个阶段。

不想下载APP连接WiFi的话，你仍可通过顶部直观按钮调节声音选项、音量、灯光颜色/亮度，启停机器。而APP端则有海量噪音设置——能用手机远程调节白噪音、音量和亮度实在太方便了！特别是当宝宝在隔壁房间时，物理按键调节会打扰他睡眠。涂鸦家庭APP对我们家非常实用，界面直观友好。

（附APP截图展示声音选项/音量/亮度控制界面，均与实机DreamEgg联动）未截图的还有：白/粉/棕/绿噪音选项、多种风扇声（飞机风扇声超赞）、9种旋律（从《小星星》到勃拉姆斯、莫扎特、竖琴循环曲和钢琴曲），都是舒缓的熟悉曲调。比如：
- 我丈夫失眠时需要电视助眠，这些旋律对他有效
- 宝宝需要持续"呼呼"声，白-绿噪音和子宫音效完美匹配
- 我偏好雨声/暴雨/海浪等自然音效——这里全都有！

设计真的考虑到了全家每个人的需求，等宝宝正式搬进儿童房后，我必须给主卧再买一台。最棒的是两台声光机都能用同一APP控制！

宝宝现在超爱子宫音效配合橙色柔光，这绝对能帮我们度过他出牙期和猛长期的睡眠倒退。此刻他正伴着暖光和子宫音效安睡，而我在隔壁房间用手机缓缓调暗灯光。洗碗或制造噪音时，我只需把APP里的声音改成平缓的粉红噪音，或调高子宫音效来维持他的睡眠。

真希望大学合租时就有这种技术——34种噪音选项确实能掩盖餐具碰撞声、日常谈话甚至夫妻电影夜的声响。闹钟功能简单易设，可定制时间/周期/铃声/音量。虽然宝宝现在就是我们的活闹钟，但这个支持灯光+渐强铃声的定制闹钟很精巧。

总之？这台纤薄美观的设备能满足所有需求：助眠、操作简易（APP/按键皆可），唯一遗憾是没配遥控器选项给不愿连接手机/WiFi的用户。对比其他家长的婴儿登记清单，我认为以这个价位，其性能、质量、功能和个性化程度都非常出色——只要APP能保持免费使用。
review_summary: 优点：声音和灯光功能超出预期，提供多种白噪音、自然声和摇篮曲，可通过App或按钮控制，App远程操作方便不打扰宝宝，性价比高，适合全家需求。缺点：App控制需付费或下载免费版Tuya Home，无法手动设置时钟，缺少遥控器选项。

review_content: Why didn't I buy these from the beginning? I struggle with finding Nursing Bras that fit and so I was worried about ordering these(spent 3 days researching fit because I have had such bad experiences in the past with nursing bras). review_content: I love the style of this bra. It’s also great it’s a pumping and nursing bra. Only down side to it is that the straps get super loose when wearing. No matter how tight you make the straps the fabric stretches out making the bra sag and have no support. I’ll order some straps connectors to make it a cross back and hopefully that fixes the problem. I got a large as I’m a 36 DD. One other thing to note is that larger breasts will barely fit or have any fabric covering the breast area when using the pumping aspect. When you unclip the nursing bra sports bra area to access the pumping ports I has minimal fabric which is odd. It’s a little over priced in my opinion for how many issues this bra has. I would return if I could but I have already worn it. I would probably seek a different bra if you are bigger chested and or like your bras to remain tight and not super loose.
